title: Page Judgement
description: Pairwise judgement of two candidate transcriptions of a page by a vision-language model.

pB_ab.description: Probability that candidate B is more faithful, asked with A first.

pA_ba.description: Probability that candidate A is more faithful, asked with B first.

pB.description: Position-debiased probability that candidate B is more faithful: (pB_ab + 1 - pA_ba) / 2.

model.description: Model identifier the server answered with.
